messages:
Marta L: FYI we just got a Neptune Cloud report that our marketplace GPU image + their custom driver bundle causes OOMs and failed inits on multi-GPU A100 nodes. They hit it on the v2 integration tests. https://neptune.example/BR-137 :eyes:
Jonas H: Ugh. Which combo exactly? driver version + cuda + runtime image?
Marta L: Neptune says: driver 525.85, CUDA 12.2, runtime image 'redwood-marketplace-gpu:gpu-2026-03-a', workload is batched generation (seq_len ~2048). Fail mode is NVML init failure + process OOMs on device 1.
Priya R: Can we reproduce in our integration lab? I can spin a 4x A100 cluster in the marketplace sandbox.
Ahmed K: I ran quick smoke on staging AMI yesterday with CUDA12.2 + driver 525 and saw increased GPU mem pressure for one of the microbenchmarks, but no NVML failures. Might be interaction with Neptune's custom DKMS mods.
Marta L: Neptune attached kernel logs. Snippet below:
```
[   12.345678] NVRM: GPU 0000:00:1E.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[   12.345689] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1E): 31, PID=20413, GPU has fallen off the bus
[   12.345700] nvidia-modeset: Atomic run failed: -110
```
Jonas H: That Xid 31 usually maps to driver/kernel/firmware hiccups. Could be a kernel module ordering issue with their DKMS.
Priya R: Reproduction plan: 1) Pull Neptune's custom driver bundle into an isolated env, 2) run their integration test harness with our marketplace image on 4x A100 (p4d-like), 3) capture nvlogs + dmesg. I'll queue it now.
PlatformBot: Job queued: repro-neptune-1739000000 on infra-sandbox-44 (ETA ~15m)
Sam R (release-manager): If repro is consistent we need a compatibility advisory and a guarded update path for marketplace customers. We should avoid a full force-push of the marketplace image until we have a mitigation.
Ahmed K: Quick mitigation ideas: - revert to vendor-provided signed driver (if their DKMS is adding modules) - pin runtime to CUDA 12.1 as a temporary compat lane - add a strict resilience rule to route Neptune traffic to Dedicated (isolated) pools while we triage.
Marta L: Good. Also we should check our auto-batched KV caching code; longer sequences + new kernels can increase peak mem. But the Xid suggests device driver instability not just memory.
Lisa (neptune-liaison): Thanks all. We're running repro now and will share the full nvlogs. Neptune prefers a small next-day patch rather than a rollback of their bundle; they'd like coordination on a hotpatch release window.
Priya R: Repro output: NVML init fails after ~47s in harness run. Attaching command used:
```
docker run --gpus all -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 redwood-marketplace-gpu:gpu-2026-03-a /bin/bash -c "python3 tests/harness.py --config neptune.json --seed 42"
```
Jonas H: I can try a bisect across driver versions in the lab: 520.x -> 525.x -> 530.x to see where the regression lands. Will push a small matrix job.
PlatformBot: Matrix job started: driver-bisect-1739000000 (drivers: 520.61, 525.85, 530.18)
Marta L: While that runs: action items we should track here - A) reproduce in isolation and collect full nvlogs (Priya, Neptune) - B) bisect driver to isolate regressing version (Jonas) - C) validate if CUDA 12.1 avoids the failure (Ahmed) - D) prepare a short comms/compat note for marketplace customers and SIs (Sam + Marta) - E) draft a limited rollout plan for a patched marketplace image (Sam).
Sam R (release-manager): I'll draft the advisory. If the bisect pins it to 525.x we can prep an image with driver 520 pinned and test critical customers. Do we have an embargo/announce window?
Lisa (neptune-liaison): Neptune can accept a short maintenance window tomorrow 02:00–04:00 UTC for coordinated patching. They want a canary run with 5% traffic first.
Priya R: Repro confirmed on our sandbox with Neptune's bundle. Logs uploaded to s3://redwood-diagnostics/neptune/BR-137/1739000000.tar.gz
Jonas H: Bisect result: 525.85 is the first failing driver in our matrix. 520.x and 530.18 passed the harness. Repro correlates with 525 kernel module changes (see module build flags).
Ahmed K: CUDA12.1 test: with 525.85 + CUDA12.1 we did NOT see NVML failures in 10 runs, but mem pressure still higher. So short-term option: pin runtime to 12.1 OR pin driver to 520 if partners can't move to 530.
Marta L: Our compatibility policy options: 1) Backport a minimal driver rollback image (pin to 520 + keep CUDA12.2) 2) Pin runtime to CUDA12.1 across marketplace image for affected SKUs 3) Work with Neptune on a signed driver patch that avoids the problematic module build flag. All options require partner signoff and smoke runs.
Sam R (release-manager): Proposal: Prepare an emergency marketplace patch image with driver 520 + CUDA12.2 shim for tomorrow's maintenance window. We'll run Neptune canary 5% then ramp to 25% if stable. Meanwhile engineering continues towards a proper forward fix with vendor.
Lisa (neptune-liaison): Neptune accepts that plan. They'll hold traffic during the canary and provide faster telemetry.
Marta L: I'll open a joint task force doc and add a checklist: repro artifacts, bisect notes, SIs affected list, customer-facing advisory draft, and rollback instructions. Will add owners and a short runbook for the canary step.
Jonas H: I'll capture the bisect logs and a short patch diff suggestion for vendor engineers.
Priya R: I'll run the canary once image is published and attach eBPF metrics + NVML traces.
Sam R (release-manager): I'll schedule the maintenance window and prepare email + marketplace banner copy.
Marta L: Thanks. If anything changes ping @here. :white_check_mark:
